body.label: Verso
body.value:
1. And there is written in it the wording of the biblical verse: “For Solomon shall be his name,
  2. and I will grant peace and quiet to Israel in his days” (1 Chronicles 22:9).
  3. And likewise the verse, “Instead of your fathers shall be your sons” (Psalm 45:17), etc. [...]
  4. The Jews who had arrived reported that news had reached [them]
  5. [that] Yaʿqūb b. Isḥāq was killed [between(?)] Tlemcen and Fez.
  6. [...] may the outcome of the dirham(s) [...] be [...] except/unto this [...]
  7. [...] concerning your term/lifetime(?) and may He suffice for us all.
  8. “God is sufficient for us, and He is the best disposer of affairs” (Qurʾān 3:173). Written in
  9. [...] of Elul.
  10. [...] and how can I remain idle? [...] And it has been discussed/reported [...]
  11. [...] to ʿAydhāb. If you know that I
  12. [...] Alexandria after the holidays, we shall join [them]/set out [...]
  13. [...] and return at the time of loading. So let me know; perhaps it will be
  14. better. [Do] as you see fit; the choice is in God’s hands.
